lines.text_raw: Stack the three tubes so they line up on one end.
lines.text_rendered: Stack the three tubes so they line up on one end.

lines.text_raw: Put the bolts through 2 plates, through the frame tubes, through the other 2 plates, and loosely put on nuts.
lines.text_rendered: Put the bolts through 2 plates, through the frame tubes, through the other 2 plates, and loosely put on nuts.

lines.text_raw: The last two holes of the plates should extend past the end of the tubes.
lines.text_rendered: The last two holes of the plates should extend past the end of the tubes.

lines.text_raw: The pictures show a 7th nut welded on. You'll install that later so don't worry about it just yet.
lines.text_rendered: The pictures show a 7th nut welded on. You'll install that later so don't worry about it just yet.

lines.text_raw: 4 14" x 1" threaded rod (TODO link to guide on cutting threaded rod)
lines.text_rendered: 4 14" x 1" threaded rod (TODO link to guide on cutting threaded rod)

lines.text_raw: Put the threaded rod through the 4 holes shown in the picture so that half the rods sticks out from each side.
lines.text_rendered: Put the threaded rod through the 4 holes shown in the picture so that half the rods sticks out from each side.

lines.text_raw: 4 pivot plates (TODO link to guide on making them) (for the ironworker, it's very important that the plates be perfectly flat against each other. If there are any bumps, grind them down.)
lines.text_rendered: 4 pivot plates (TODO link to guide on making them) (for the ironworker, it's very important that the plates be perfectly flat against each other. If there are any bumps, grind them down.)

lines.text_raw: 0.5 ounces of grease (Dan made this up, Marcin should verify)
lines.text_rendered: 0.5 ounces of grease (Dan made this up, Marcin should verify)

lines.text_raw: Put two pivot plates on each side of the frame tubes over the 4 threaded rods.
lines.text_rendered: Put two pivot plates on each side of the frame tubes over the 4 threaded rods.

lines.text_raw: Grease the inside of the bushing (round area) on the pivot plates.
lines.text_rendered: Grease the inside of the bushing (round area) on the pivot plates.

lines.text_raw: Put two plates on each side of the frame tubes.
lines.text_rendered: Put two plates on each side of the frame tubes.

lines.text_raw: Add 2 pivot plates to each side and then put on the nuts loosely.
lines.text_rendered: Add 2 pivot plates to each side and then put on the nuts loosely.

lines.text_raw: Put the bolts through the plate, through the frame tubes, through the other plate, and fasten loosely with nuts.
lines.text_rendered: Put the bolts through the plate, through the frame tubes, through the other plate, and fasten loosely with nuts.

lines.text_raw: Put the bolts through two plates, through the tubes, through the other two plates, and fasten the nuts loosely.
lines.text_rendered: Put the bolts through two plates, through the tubes, through the other two plates, and fasten the nuts loosely.

lines.text_raw: Turn the upper frame upside down so that the pivot plates are resting on the ground.
lines.text_rendered: Turn the upper frame upside down so that the pivot plates are resting on the ground.

lines.text_raw: Slide threaded rod through upper frame tubing. Put a washer and nut on each end.
lines.text_rendered: Slide threaded rod through upper frame tubing. Put a washer and nut on each end.

lines.text_raw: Tighten all nuts and bolts except for the 4 that go through the pivot plates.
lines.text_rendered: Tighten all nuts and bolts except for the 4 that go through the pivot plates.
